name: harness-lite
goal: Verify SvelteKit and Godot logic in a browser-free 1 GB and 0.5 vCPU run, then add visual proof for the same commit in full mode.

evidence: Exact-commit full remains the default. Lite runs the non-browser checks on the same declared states, records deferred browser checks and visual captures, and cannot prove the full gate. Prove unchanged-commit upgrade plus peak memory, CPU and time in cgroups.

Browser-free exact-commit Lite, headless Godot, deferred coverage and independent one-page capture implemented. Both constrained fixtures passed and were upgraded to full screenshots on MB2. The captured single page renders in ARM64 Chromium Headless Shell.

At 71e223d767, 168 focused tests and five verification E2Es passed. Source ownership reviews and typechecking passed. Both real fixtures passed under the capped worker and gained exact-commit full screenshots.
